user.title: Wattr Pool Controller Setup
user.description:
Configure your Wattr pool controller integration.
 Fetch your API key at https://wattr.sempl.energy/tokenLogin and enter the serial number of your device. 
**Energy Optimization:**
Do you want to boost/reduce energy consumption of your heatpump depending on sensor data? You can link a sensor (like your energy meter) to automatically optimize your pool's energy usage. Make sure to set the boosting/reducing thresholds in the Wattr app configuration.
